extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons institutional users and administrators (Signing Officials, TTO Administrators, AAs/AOs/ASST/BO/FSR/PIs/SPONSORs) who manage delegations and the Institution Profile (IPF)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures, required fields, role-based access, and UI behaviors for delegating authorities and for viewing/editing the Institution Profile (IPF) in eRA Commons. Covers delegation search/edit/remove, dashboard/status indicators, and each IPF component's required/optional fields and editing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation: mark specific authority checkboxes
rubrics_metrics.description: Mark the checkbox of the specific authority being delegated (e.g., PPF) for the user being delegated. Multiple authorities may be selected if available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NOTE: Clicking the Select All button selects all available authorities. After saving, Commons grants the specified authority and the delegated users receive an email informing them of the change. The Search Results area updates with the assigned authorities marked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation: save to apply changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Select the Save button to save delegation selections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commons grants the specified authority for the selected users and sends them an email informing them of the change. Use the Return to My Current Delegations link to go back. Selecting Cancel cancels the action and returns the My Delegates screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation: Search parameters and usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for delegates using Commons ID, Last Name, First Name, Middle Name, and Role(s). Roles display in a drop-down list where one or more may be selected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If necessary, the percent sign (%) may be used as a wildcard character. Hold down the CTRL key when selecting roles to select more than one. Select the Search button to run the search. Selecting the Cancel button cancels the search and returns the previous screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation: interpretation of Search Results
rubrics_metrics.description: Matching users display in the Search Results area including name, role(s), Commons ID, and delegated authorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any marked checkboxes under the Progress Report, Sponsor, Submit, PPF, Status, and xTrain authorities indicate that the user already has the specific authority. If multiple users match, results may span pages—use next/previous or first/last arrows. The Clear button clears search parameters and results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit Delegations: adding or revoking authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Edit a user's delegations by selecting the user and marking or unmarking the authority checkboxes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authorities can be marked to add or unmarked to revoke. Select Save to save changes. Commons grants and/or revokes the specified authority and emails the user. If all authorities are revoked, that user no longer displays in My Current Delegations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove Delegations: uncheck and save
rubrics_metrics.description: Remove delegations by unchecking the appropriate authority checkbox(es) for the selected user and selecting Save.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commons revokes the specified authority and emails the user. My Current Delegates shows the delegated user with checkmarks removed; if all are revoked the user disappears from the table. Selecting Cancel cancels the action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution must be registered to use Commons features
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutions must be registered in Commons in order to use its features; the Institution Profile (IPF) is populated after institutional account creation and assigned a unique IPF number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The IPF number uniquely identifies and associates institutional information within the NIH enterprise database.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPF: content and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The IPF is a central repository of organizational information necessary for grant applications (preferred institution name, SO contact info, DUNS, institutional assurances, emails for NoA and notifications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The IPF allows institutional Signing Officials (SO) to electronically maintain external organization profile information necessary for all grant applications from their institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPF: role-based access—view vs edit
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to the IPF module is limited by Commons role; not every user can view/edit all information. Only users with the SO role can edit most IPF components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you hold one of the following Commons roles, you have access to the Institution Profile: AA, AO, ASST, BO, FSR, PI, POSTDOC, SCIENTIST, SPONSOR, or SO. For most users, available information displays as read-only. Only SO (or TTO admin in specific situations) may edit.

rubrics_metrics.name: iEdison/TTO exceptions to editing rights
rubrics_metrics.description: iEdison module uses parts of the Institution Profile; some iEdison users can access it. iEdison TTO users and admin can view the profile; only TTO admin can edit the information. TTO Administrator can edit all sections if there is no Signing Official.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For institutions with both a Signing Official and TTO Administrator, the TTO Administrator can only edit the Extramural Technology Transfer Administration component.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPF dashboard status indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Dashboard navigation links show a status indicator next to each link: a green checkmark indicates the information is complete, while a red X indicates information is missing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Assurances & Certifications, the green check indicates that the ORI Certification is valid and not expired. Dashboard also shows Accounts, Profile Updated date, ORI Certification Expires date, and eRA Help Desk information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of online help icons
rubrics_metrics.description: Select any question mark ('?') icon within the Institution Profile to access component-specific help topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Help icons are located on each Institution Profile page heading and within each component's heading and lead to relevant help topics (also accessible at http://era.nih.gov/erahelp/commons).

rubrics_metrics.name: View mode behaviors
rubrics_metrics.description: View mode provides a read-only summary of information within a specific component; not all maintained fields are displayed in view mode.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methods to view: click component heading, select the View button on a component header, select View for multiple components, or select View All to expand all summaries. Hide or Hide All collapses them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit mode behaviors and Save All requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: If you hold the SO role, selecting Edit opens fields for editing; Save All is the only method to save changes across components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting Save All keeps you in edit mode so you can continue saving work. Hiding or closing components is not the same as saving; if you navigate away without selecting Save All, changes will be lost. To discard changes, use Discard Changes and confirm Yes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Component tiles: expand/collapse methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Component tiles can be expanded by clicking the heading, selecting View All, selecting the View button, or selecting Edit (SO only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use View All to expand all tiles for viewing or editing; use Hide/Hide All to collapse them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required-field error indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: If any required information is missing, a message displays across the top of the screen, the Basic Information link in the dashboard displays in red font, and the header of the component in error displays in red. There is also a field-level error message in red text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the help topics for each individual profile component to see what fields are available for editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution Name component: editable Preferred Name
rubrics_metrics.description: Institution Name component shows Profile Name and Commons Preferred Name. SO can edit the Commons Preferred Name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Preferred Name is not a required field. After editing, select Save All to save changes or Discard Changes to cancel. Only SO role (or TTO Administrator in absence of SO) can edit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution Contact Information: required fields and their uses
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact component fields that are required for editing: Notice of Award Email, Announcements & Notifications Email, Closeout Correspondence Email, Contact Name, Contact Phone, Contact Email.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIH uses the Notice of Award Email to send all notices of award. Announcements & Notifications Email receives grant reminders, system notifications, and general correspondence. Closeout Correspondence Email is used for Closeout-related communications. Contact Name is considered the primary contact for the institution; enter phone and email for that person.

rubrics_metrics.name: About the Institution: DUNS and assurances editing rules
rubrics_metrics.description: About the Institution contains Primary DUNS, Secondary DUNS, Federal-Wide Assurance Numbers, Animal Welfare Assurance Number, Organization Type, and Ownership Control. SO can edit specific fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Secondary DUNS: SOs can add (enter 9 digits and optional 4 digits for 13-digit DUNS), edit, or remove secondary DUNS. Federal-Wide Assurance Numbers: add/edit/remove via Add and Remove buttons. Animal Welfare Assurance Number displays values from OLAW and is not editable. Primary DUNS, Organization Type, and Ownership Control are read-only; to change Primary DUNS contact eRA Help Desk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Cost Negotiations: fields and format
rubrics_metrics.description: Indirect Cost Negotiations component includes Negotiator Name and Last Negotiation Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If editable, Negotiator Name: name of agent who negotiated the most recent indirect cost agreement. Last Negotiation: enter the date of the most recent negotiation (format must be MM/DD/YYYY). Save All to persist changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signing Officials and TTO Administrators: displayed information
rubrics_metrics.description: This component lists all Commons users in your organization assigned SO and/or TTO Administrator roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed read-only fields: Name, Phone Number, Email Address. View by clicking tile header or selecting View.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution Address: required and optional fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Institution Address component fields include Street Address (required), City (required), Country (required), State (required), Zip Code (required), Phone (required), Fax (optional).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select Edit (SO only) to change; when done select Save All. Remember hiding a component is not saving. Use Discard Changes to cancel since last Save All.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extramural Technology Transfer Administration: fields and edit rights
rubrics_metrics.description: This component shows TTO contact information and settings: Address, Contact Name, Phone, Email, Are batch uploads allowed, The month that begins utilization period, Are inventions assigned for administration and reporting by the user?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This component is maintained by iEdison users holding Extramural TTO administrator role; SO may also edit. If you hold the TTO_Admin or SO role you can edit these fields. Batch uploads and assignment options are selected from drop-down lists (Yes/No); utilization month also selected from a drop-down.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Assurances and Certifications: status display rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Status section displays the Office of Research and Integrity (ORI) Certification Status: values are Assurance OK or Expired. Expired status displays in red text as a warning; the expiration date displays below the status (red if already expired).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assurances and Certifications section lists compliance indicators with read-only check marks and the date the institution indicated compliance. Policy note: not all assurances/certifications apply to every institution; refer to Part III (Policies, Assurances, Definitions and Other Information) of the SF424 (R&R) Application Guide for definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing Assurances & Certifications
rubrics_metrics.description: SO role users can edit assurance and certification indicators in the Institution Profile by selecting the Edit Assurances and Certifications button.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the Edit Assurances and Certifications button at the top of the screen to change indicators; Save All to persist changes.
